description: A crawl's status, page counts, credits used and page results (paged by cursor). Can wait for it to finish. Free.

id.description: Job id from the start call.

include_content.description: false = results without content. Default true.

max_content_chars.description: Clip each page's content to this many chars (default 4000).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to finish (default 0).

name: get_crawl_status
title: Get Crawl Status
